description: This file contains tests for utility functions related to credits management, including conversion rates and data normalization checks for a dashboard project.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieves the current credits per USD rate, defaulting to 20000 if environment variable is unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits, returns 0 for invalid inputs, uses environment variable CREDITS_PER_USD for conversion rate.
